status.mcp.bad_name: Name: lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (max 32), and not "hokma".
status.mcp.bad_url: The address must start with https://
status.mcp.no_login: There is no sign-in in progress for this server. Press Connect again.
status.mcp.no_store: This computer has no secure credential store available. Hokma does not keep the access anywhere else.
status.mcp.no_registration: This server does not let Hokma register by itself ({output}). Ask the provider for access with dynamic registration.
status.mcp.not_mcp: That address is not an MCP server: it answered {output}. Check that it is the MCP server address (for example https://mcp.lauz.io/mcp) and not the web page.
status.mcp.unreachable: The server could not be reached ({output}). Check the address and your connection.
status.mcp.rejected: The server rejected the access it just issued (HTTP {status}). Press Connect again.
status.mcp.page.ok_text: Connected, you can close this tab. Hokma is already up to date.
status.mcp.page.fail_text: {output}. Close this tab and press Connect again in Hokma.
status.ext.install.no_claude: Claude Code was not found on this computer, so the plugin could not be installed.
status.ext.install.timeout: The installation took more than {seconds} seconds and was cancelled.
status.ext.install.not_run: Claude Code could not be run: {error}
status.ext.install.bad_source: The source of this marketplace is not an address Hokma can install from safely.
status.ext.install.not_recorded: Claude Code finished without errors but {plugin} was not recorded on disk.
status.ext.install.uninstall_failed: Claude Code could not delete the files of {plugin}: {reason}
status.ext.state.installing: Installing with Claude Code, it can take a couple of minutes.
status.ext.state.claude_only: This plugin works with Claude Code. Your current engine is another one, so it is not used in your conversations.
status.ext.state.worker_down: The files of {plugin} are there, but its worker does not answer on port {port}. It starts with its hooks when you open a conversation with Claude Code; if it stays like this, check that Bun is installed.
